prompt: Customers report that cart totals from the cart package are wrong in several situations: some discounted carts are off by a cent, some coupon combinations give too much or too little discount, and tax on carts that mix taxable and tax-exempt items looks wrong. The pricing rules are documented on Cart.Totals and on mulDivRound. Find every place where the code departs from those rules, fix it, and make sure `go test ./...` passes.
